title: wg: draft-mahy-mls-ext-commit-pp-02 gaps (RFC 9420 by-reference rule, which proposals, encryption)
description:
From assay mimid-1wgh.44.8 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mls-ext-commit-pp-02.txt. Posting needs Mark's OK.

1. RFC 9420 §12.4.3.2 says an external Commit MUST NOT include any proposals by reference (rfc9420.xml L5732). §4 requires exactly that when the extension is required but never says it updates or overrides that rule, nor how a receiver that requires the extension validates such a commit.
2. Which proposals: §4 says 'all the pending proposals provided to it'. RFC 9420 limits what an external Commit may contain; say which proposal types are allowed by reference here (e.g. Add, Update, GCE, AppDataUpdate) and what happens to ones that are not.
3. Visibility: the GroupInfo provider can only pass on proposals it can read, i.e. PublicMessage (or SemiPrivateMessage to it). Say so, and how a joiner checks it got all of them (it cannot; §5.1 covers invalid ones, not omitted ones). protocol-07's PendingProposal list (L2236-2246) is the obvious source; cite it.
4. Stale cite: SelfRemove is 'Section 6.4 of [I-D.ietf-mls-extensions]' (§3.1); in -11 it is §6.3. Reference list is -10.
5. Typos: 'dilema', 'a bundle a proposals', 'validates by' (§5.2), 'at the time' (§5.1, likely 'at the same time').
notes: Mark 2026-11-16: post this with a line that mimid has the H4 problem and would implement the draft if adopted (decision .44.25). Still needs Mark's OK on the text.
